rationale: The short thesis is intact — price remains ~4.3% below session VWAP, below the 9-EMA ($8.66), and on a risk-off tape (SPY -0.76%, VIXY +2.66%), and the seven minutes since entry show only a low-volume drift off the low with highs capped at $8.47 and no absorption or bounce to signal a reversal. The stall has given back part of the favorable excursion, but exiting here means covering at the $8.47 ask — a scratch after commissions — while risk stays cleanly defined at the original $8.68 invalidation (~$149, well inside the $549 remaining budget). Holding for continuation toward fresh lows is the higher-expectancy path; a flip to long lacks any reversal confirmation (no reclaim, no volume spike) and would be fighting the tape.
